data.title: bn-2n0: Add temporal visual assertions and semantic lint
data.description: Review temporal boundary/consecutive comparisons, allowed regions, deterministic heatmaps, preserved evidence on assertion failure, tag-aware semantic warnings, strict pre-execution validation, docs, and no aesthetic-score behavior. Full just check passes.

data.body: [P1] Make the edge contrast cutoff game-authored. This >= 24 threshold is neither present in traversal_corridor_edges nor documented, yet it decides which pixels count toward the authored max_edge_fraction. That contradicts the review contract that games choose all thresholds and Console does not infer taste, and two otherwise identical scenarios cannot tune the lint for low-contrast versus high-contrast palettes. Add a validated field such as min_luma_delta (and report it in actual/limit), or explicitly revise the contract if this is intended to be a fixed algorithm parameter.

[P1] Do not use presentation-label prefixes as source identity. Valid unique names can collide: selecting ordinary stages named 'foo' and 'foo F1' makes the 'foo' prefix match both sources, so boundary evaluation fails after the cart has loaded even though preflight proved one source; the same issue exists for layer tags such as 'bg' and 'bg @ variant' at lines 806-814. Carry exact stage/tag identity beside the human label (or preflight/reject every ambiguous generated label) so source selection is exact and every accepted schema remains executable after preflight.

data.reason: Two P1 contract issues: traversal edge lint has an undocumented hidden cutoff, and temporal/lint sources are selected by collision-prone label prefixes instead of exact identity.

data.body: Fixed: traversal_corridor_edges now requires explicit min_luma_delta alongside max_edge_fraction; implementation and JSON report use that authored threshold, and SPEC documents it.

Fixed: DiagnosticSource now carries an exact typed Stage/Layer selector; temporal and lint lookup no longer parse display labels. Regression covers colliding stage names foo / foo F1 and tags bg / bg @ variant.

data.reason: LGTM after ff6d5e8: min_luma_delta is explicit, documented, applied, and reported; typed Stage/Layer selectors remove label-prefix identity collisions, with focused regression coverage. Focused playtest tests and clippy pass.
